theorem algebra_10503 {A B : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, x ≠ 7 ∧ x ≠ -6 → (3 * x + 5) / (x ^ 2 - x - 42) = A / (x - 7) + B / (x + 6)) :

theorem algebra_277724 (x : ℝ) : 3 * x ^ 3 - ⌊x⌋ = 3 ↔ x = (4 / 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
formal_proof:

theorem algebra_277724 (x : ℝ) : 3 * x ^ 3 - ⌊x⌋ = 3 ↔ x = (4 / 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume 3 * x ^ 3 - ⌊x⌋ = 3, prove x = (4 / 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
    intro h_eq
    let n := ⌊x⌋
    have hn1 : n ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact Int.floor_le x
    have hn2 : x < (n + 1 : ℝ) := by exact Int.lt_floor_add_one x
    have h_eq2 : 3 * x ^ 3 - (n : ℝ) = 3 := by
      simpa using h_eq
    have h_eq3 : 3 * x ^ 3 = 3 + (n : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    have h_eq4 : x ^ 3 = 1 + (n : ℝ) / 3 := by
      nlinarith
    have h1 : n ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have h2 : n ≥ 2 := by omega
      have h3 : (n : ℝ) ≥ (2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 - (2 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (2 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (1 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (4 / 3 : ℝ)), h_eq3, hn1, hn2, h3]
    have h2 : n ≥ 1 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have h3 : n ≤ 0 := by omega
      have h4 : (n : ℝ) ≤ (0 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h3
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 - (1 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (1 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (0 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (4 / 3 : ℝ)), h_eq3, hn1, hn2, h4]
    have hn : n = 1 := by omega
    have h5 : (n : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hx3 : x ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [h_eq3, h5]
    have hx : x = (4 / 3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
      have h1 : x ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := hx3
      have h2 : x = (x ^ 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul]
        norm_num
        all_goals linarith
      rw [h2, h1]
      all_goals norm_num
    exact hx
  · -- Assume x = (4 / 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3), prove 3 * x ^ 3 - ⌊x⌋ = 3
    intro h_eq
    have hx3 : x ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      rw [h_eq]
      have h1 : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul]
        norm_num
        all_goals norm_num
      linarith
    have hn1 : ⌊x⌋ = 1 := by
      have h1 : 1 < x := by
        rw [h_eq]
        have h : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) > (1 : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : (1 : ℝ) < (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by norm_num
          have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (1 : ℝ) := by
            simp
          have h3 : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) > (1 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
            apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow
            · norm_num
            · linarith
            · norm_num
          linarith [h2, h3]
        linarith
      have h2 : x < (2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [h_eq]
        have h : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) < (2 : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : (4 / 3 : ℝ) < (8 : ℝ) := by norm_num
          have h2 : (8 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (2 : ℝ) := by
            have h1 : (8 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (2 : ℝ) := by
              rw [show (8 : ℝ) = 2 ^ (3 : ℝ) by norm_num]
              simp [Real.rpow_mul]
            linarith
          have h3 : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) < (8 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
            apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow
            · linarith
            · linarith
            · norm_num
          linarith [h2, h3]
        linarith
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      constructor <;> (try norm_num) <;> nlinarith
    have h_eq2 : (⌊x⌋ : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
    have h_eq3 : 3 * x ^ 3 = 4 := by
      nlinarith [hx3]
    linarith [h_eq3, h_eq2]

/- 2. Solve the equation

$$
\left(x^{2}+x+2\right)^{x^{2}+x+1}=9
$$ -/
theorem algebra_220794 (x : ℝ) : (x^2 + x + 2)^(x^2 + x + 1) = 9 ↔
    x = (-1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 ∨ x = (-1 - Real.sqrt 5) / 2 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_220794 (x : ℝ) : (x^2 + x + 2)^(x^2 + x + 1) = 9 ↔
    x = (-1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 ∨ x = (-1 - Real.sqrt 5) / 2 := by 
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: If (x^2 + x + 2)^(x^2 + x + 1) = 9, then x = (-1 ±√5)/2
    intro h_eq
    have h1 : x^2 + x + 2 > 0 := by 
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 1 / 2)]
    have h2 : (x^2 + x + 1) * (Real.log (x^2 + x + 2)) = Real.log 9 := by
      have h4 : Real.log ((x^2 + x + 2) ^ (x^2 + x + 1)) = Real.log 9 := by
        rw [h_eq]
      have h3 : Real.log ((x^2 + x + 2) ^ (x^2 + x + 1)) = (x^2 + x + 1) * Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow]
        all_goals nlinarith
      linarith [h4, h3]
    have h3 : x^2 + x + 1 = (2 : ℝ) := by
      by_cases h5 : x^2 + x + 1 < (2 : ℝ)
      · -- Case where x^2 + x + 1 < 2
        have h6 : x^2 + x + 1 < (2 : ℝ) := h5
        have h61 : x^2 + x + 2 < (3 : ℝ) := by nlinarith
        have h62 : x^2 + x + 2 > (1 : ℝ) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 1 / 2)]
        have h8 : Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) < Real.log (3 : ℝ) := by 
          apply Real.log_lt_log
          all_goals nlinarith
        have h9 : 0 < Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) := by 
          apply Real.log_pos
          nlinarith
        -- Now we need to show it's contradiction 
        have h64 : (x^2 + x + 1) * Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) < Real.log 9 := by 
          have h8' : Real.log 9 = (2 * Real.log (3 : ℝ)) := by 
            calc 
              Real.log 9 = Real.log (3 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num 
              _ = 2 * Real.log (3 : ℝ) := by simp [Real.log_pow]
          nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (x^2 + x + 1 : ℝ) by nlinarith, Real.log_pos (show (3 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num)]
        -- The original equality can't hold from h64
        have h7 : Real.log 9 = (x^2 + x + 1) * Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) := by 
          linarith [h2]
        linarith
      · -- Now that left is dis proven, move to right
        by_cases h6 : x^2 + x + 1 > (2 : ℝ)
        · -- Now handle the case > 2
          have h7 : x^2 + x + 1 > (2 : ℝ) := h6
          have h71 : x^2 + x + 2 > (3 : ℝ) := by
            nlinarith
          -- For greater value, the Real.log will also be higher
          have h9 : Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) > Real.log (3 : ℝ) := by
            apply Real.log_lt_log
            all_goals nlinarith
          -- Now to derive a real contradiction
          have h73 : (x^2 + x + 1) * Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) > Real.log 9 := by 
            have h8' : Real.log 9 = (2 * Real.log (3 : ℝ)) := by 
              calc 
                Real.log 9 = Real.log (3 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num 
                _ = 2 * Real.log (3 : ℝ) := by simp [Real.log_pow]
            nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (x^2 + x + 1 : ℝ) by nlinarith, Real.log_pos (show (3 : ℝ) > 1 by norm_num), show 0 < Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) by apply Real.log_pos; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 1 / 2)]]
          -- The original equality can't hold from h73
          have h72 : Real.log 9 = (x^2 + x + 1) * Real.log (x^2 + x + 2) := by 
            linarith [h2]
          linarith 
        · -- The only solution left is =
          linarith 
    -- Now we get a specific value 
    have h4 : x^2 + x - 1 = 0 := by
      nlinarith 
    have : x = (-1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 ∨ x = (-1 - Real.sqrt 5) / 2 := by 
      have h6 : x^2 + x - 1 = 0 := h4 
      have h70 : (x - (-1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) * (x - (-1 - Real.sqrt 5) / 2) = 0 := by 
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < 5 by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      cases' (mul_eq_zero.1 h70) with h60 h50
      · -- Either root 
        left 
        linarith 
      · -- Or the other root 
        right 
        linarith 
    assumption 
  · -- Reverse direction: If x = (-1 ±√5)/2, then (x^2 +x+2)^(x^2+x+1)=9
    rintro (h_eq | h_eq)
    · -- First solution 
      rw [h_eq] 
      -- Verify the first solution $(-1 + Real.sqrt 5)/2$ 
      -- Explicitly calculating the powers $x^2 +x +2$ and exponent 
      have h10 : ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 1 = (2 : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < 5 by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      have h11 : ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 2 = (3 : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < 5 by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      rw [show ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 2 = (3 : ℝ) by linarith [h11]]
      rw [show ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 + Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 1 = (2 : ℝ) by linarith [h10]]
      all_goals norm_num 
      all_goals nlinarith 
    · -- Second solution 
      rw [h_eq] 
      -- Verify the second solution $(-1 - Real.sqrt 5)/2$ 
      -- Explicitly calculating the powers $x^2 +x +2$ and exponent 
      have h10 : ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 1 = (2 : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < 5 by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      have h11 : ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 2 = (3 : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) < 5 by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      rw [show ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 2 = (3 : ℝ) by linarith [h11]]
      rw [show ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 + ((-1 - Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) / 2) + 1 = (2 : ℝ) by linarith [h10]]
      all_goals norm_num
      all_goals nlinarith 
    all_goals linarith

/- Prove that any multivariate polynomial $P(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n)$ with real coefficients can be expressed as the difference of two multivariate polynomials $Q(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n)$ and $R(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n)$, both with real coefficients, such that $Q(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \geq 0$ and $R(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \geq 0$ for all real values of $x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n$. -/
theorem algebra_18 {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} :
    ∃ Q R : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      P = Q - R ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial

theorem algebra_18 {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} :
    ∃ Q R : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      P = Q - R ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,
        MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 := by 
  use P ^ 2 + 1 
  use P ^ 2 + 1 - P 
  constructor
  · -- Show P = Q - R 
    ring_nf 
  · -- Show ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 
    intro x 
    have h1 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1) ≥ 0 := by
      have eq1 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1) = (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + (1 : ℝ) := by 
        simp [pow_two, MvPolynomial.eval_add, MvPolynomial.eval_pow]
      rw [eq1] 
      have h3 : (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by 
        apply sq_nonneg 
      linarith 
    have h2 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1 - P) ≥ 0 := by 
      have eq2 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1 - P) = (MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1)) - (MvPolynomial.eval x P) := by 
        simp [MvPolynomial.eval_sub] 
      rw [eq2] 
      have eq1' : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1) = (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + (1 : ℝ) := by 
        simp [pow_two, MvPolynomial.eval_add, MvPolynomial.eval_pow]
      rw [eq1']
      have h4 : (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + (1 : ℝ) - (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ≥ 0 := by 
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((MvPolynomial.eval x P) - (1 / 2 : ℝ))]
      linarith 
    constructor 
    · -- Show MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 
      linarith [h1] 
    · -- Show MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 
      linarith [h2]

theorem algebra_96166 {x : ℝ} (hx : x = sqrt (1 + sqrt (1 + sqrt 1))) :

open Real

theorem algebra_96166 {x : ℝ} (hx : x = sqrt (1 + sqrt (1 + sqrt 1))) :
    (x ^ 4) = 3 + 2 * sqrt 2 := by

    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> norm_num
  have h2 : sqrt (1 + sqrt 1) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [h1]
    norm_num
  have h3 : x = Real.sqrt (1 + Real.sqrt 2) := by
    rw [hx]
    rw [h2]

    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]

    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]

/- Given the sequence $\left\{ {{a}_{n}} \right\}$ satisfies ${{a}_{1}}=\frac{1}{2}$, ${{a}_{n}}=2{{a}_{n}}{{a}_{n+1}}+3{{a}_{n+1}}\left( n\in {{\mathbf{N}}^{*}} \right)$

Find the general term formula of the sequence $\left\{ {{a}_{n}} \right\}$; -/
theorem algebra_11896 {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha1 : a 1 = 1 / 2)
    (han : ∀ n ≥ 1, a n = 2 * a n * a (n + 1) + 3 * a (n + 1)) :
    ∀ n ≥ 1, a n = 1 / (3 ^ n - 1) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_11896 {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha1 : a 1 = 1 / 2)
    (han : ∀ n ≥ 1, a n = 2 * a n * a (n + 1) + 3 * a (n + 1)) :
    ∀ n ≥ 1, a n = 1 / (3 ^ n - 1) := by
  intro n hn
  induction n with
  | zero => linarith -- base case n = 0, impossible as n ≥ 1
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      rw [ha1]
      norm_num
      <;> field_simp
      <;> norm_num
    | succ n =>
      have ih' := ih (by linarith)
      have h8 := han (n + 1) (by linarith)
      have h9 : a (n + 2) = a (n + 1) / (2 * a (n + 1) + 3) := by
        -- Rewrite from `h8` to get expression from term `n` to term `n+1`
        -- invert solve from `a (n+1) = 2 * a (n+1) * a (n+2) + 3 * a (n+2)`
        -- to `a (n+2) = a (n+1) / (2 * a (n+1) + 3)`
        have h10 : 2 * a (n + 1) + 3 ≠ 0 := by
          by_contra h
          have h11 : a (n + 1) = -3 / 2 := by linarith
          rw [h11] at h8
          norm_num at h8
          all_goals nlinarith [ih']
        have h12 : (2 * a (n + 1) + 3) ≠ 0 := h10
        field_simp [h12]
        nlinarith
      rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega]
      rw [h9]
      rw [ih']
      have h_pos : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
      have h_nonzero : (3 ^ (n + 1) - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        have h1 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 1 := by
          have h2 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≥ (3 : ℝ) ^ 1 := by
            apply pow_le_pow_right
            all_goals nlinarith
          have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ^ 1 = 3 := by norm_num
          have h4 : (3 : ℝ) > 1 := by norm_num
          nlinarith [h2, h3]
        nlinarith
      field_simp
      ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [show (3 ^ (n : ℕ) : ℝ) > 0 by positivity]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> norm_num
      <;> try { 
        have h_zero : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
        nlinarith
      }
      <;> try { 
        have h_zero : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
        have h_zero' : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n) > 0 := by positivity
        field_simp
      }
      <;> try { 
        have h_zero : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
        have h_zero' : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n) > 0 := by positivity
        nlinarith
      }
      <;> try { 
        have h_zero : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
        have h_zero' : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n) > 0 := by positivity
        have eq1 : ( -3 * ((-1 + 3 ^ n * 3) : ℝ) + 2 * (-1 + 3 ^ n * 3)⁻¹ - 3 ^ n * 6 * (-1 + 3 ^ n * 3)⁻¹ ) = 0 := by 
          field_simp
          <;> ring
          <;> field_simp
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((3 ^ n) : ℝ), sq_nonneg ((3 ^ (n + 1) : ℝ)), sq_nonneg ((-1 + 3 ^ n * 3) : ℝ), h_pos, h_nonzero]
      }
      <;> try { 
        exfalso
      }
      <;> try { 
        tauto
      }
      <;> try { 
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((3 ^ (n + 1) - 1) : ℝ), sq_nonneg ((3 ^ (n + 1) - 1) : ℝ), h_pos, h_nonzero, sq_nonneg ((-1 + 3 ^ n * 3) : ℝ), sq_nonneg ((-1 + 3 ^ (n) * 3) : ℝ)]
      }
      all_goals try { 
          exfalso
          <;> try { 
            tauto
          }
          <;> try { 
            exfalso
            <;> tauto
          }
      }
      all_goals try { 
        exfalso
        try { exfalso <;> linarith [sq_nonneg ((3 ^ (n + 1) - 1) : ℝ), sq_nonneg ((3 ^ (n + 1) - 1) : ℝ), h_pos, h_nonzero, sq_nonneg ((-1 + 3 ^ n * 3) : ℝ), sq_nonneg ((-1 + 3 ^ n * 3) : ℝ)] }
        try { 
          have h_zero : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n) > 0 := by positivity
          linarith [sq_nonneg (a (n + 1)), sq_nonneg (a (n + 1) * a (n + 2)), sq_nonneg (a (n + 2)), sq_nonneg (a (n + 1) * a (n + 1)), sq_nonneg ((3 ^ (n + 1) - 1) * a (n + 1))]
        }
      }

/- The sum of an infinite geometric series with common ratio $r$ such that $|r|<1$ is $15$, and the sum of the squares of the terms of this series is $45$. The first term of the series is
$\textbf{(A) } 12\quad \textbf{(B) } 10\quad \textbf{(C) } 5\quad \textbf{(D) } 3\quad \textbf{(E) 2}$ -/
theorem algebra_96267 {a r : ℝ} (hr : |r| < 1)
(hsum : ∑' n : ℕ, a * r ^ n = 15) (hsumsq : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = 45) :

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_96267 {a r : ℝ} (hr : |r| < 1)
(hsum : ∑' n : ℕ, a * r ^ n = 15) (hsumsq : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = 45) :
a = 5 := by
  have h1 : ∑' n : ℕ, a * r ^ n = a / (1 - r) := by
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one]
    · ring
    · -- Show that |r| < 1
      simpa using hr
  have h2 : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = a^2 / (1 - r^2) := by
    have h : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℕ, a^2 * (r^2) ^ n := by
      congr
      funext n
      ring_nf
    rw [h]
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one]
    · ring
    · -- Show that |r^2| < 1
      have h3 : |r ^ 2| < 1 := by
        have h4 : r^2 < 1 := by
          nlinarith [abs_lt.mp hr, sq_nonneg r]
        have h5 : -1 < r^2 := by
          nlinarith [abs_lt.mp hr, sq_nonneg r]
        apply abs_lt.mpr
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      simpa using h3
  rw [h1] at hsum
  rw [h2] at hsumsq
  have h3 : r ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    -- Now r = 1
    have h4 : |r| = 1 := by
      rw [h]
      norm_num [abs]
    have h5 : |r| < (1 : ℝ) := hr
    linarith [h4, h5]
  have eq3 : a = 15 * (1 - r) := by
    have h4 : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have h3' : r = 1 := by
        linarith
      tauto -- This would use that r ≠ 1 (from h3)
    field_simp [h4] at hsum
    linarith
  have eq4 : 1 - r ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have h5 : r^2 = 1 := by
      linarith
    have h6 : r = 1 ∨ r = -1 := by
      have : r^2 - 1 = 0 := by linarith
      have : (r - 1) * (r + 1) = 0 := by linarith
      cases (mul_eq_zero.1 this) with
      | inl h1 =>
        left
        linarith
      | inr h2 =>
        right
        linarith
    cases h6 with
    | inl h7 =>
      exfalso
      have h3' : r = 1 := h7
      have h3 : r = 1 := h3'
      tauto
    | inr h8 =>
      exfalso
      -- r=-1 implies |r|=1 which is not less than 1
      have h9 : |r| = 1 := by
        rw [show r = -1 by linarith [h8] ]
        norm_num [abs]
      have h10 : |r| < (1 : ℝ) := hr
      linarith [h9, h10]
  field_simp [eq4] at hsumsq
  rw [show a = 15 * (1 - r) by linarith [eq3] ] at hsumsq
  have hquadratic : (r - 1) * (3 * r - 2) = 0 := by
    nlinarith
  cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp hquadratic) with h7 h8
  · -- Case r - 1 = 0, so r = 1
    have h9 : r = 1 := by linarith
    exfalso
    tauto
  · -- Case 3r - 2 = 0, so r = 2/3
    have h11 : r = 2 / 3 := by linarith
    rw [h11] at eq3
    nlinarith

lemma lemma_1 (x : ℝ) (h : Real.sin (2 * x) ≠ 0) :

    linarith

    rw [Real.sin_two_mul]

    by_contra h2
    have h3 : Real.sin (2 * x) = 0 := by
      rw [show Real.sin (2 * x) = 2 * Real.sin x * Real.cos x by rw [Real.sin_two_mul]]
      rw [h2]
      norm_num
    contradiction
  have hcos : Real.cos x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h2
    have h3 : Real.sin (2 * x) = 0 := by
      rw [show Real.sin (2 * x) = 2 * Real.sin x * Real.cos x by rw [Real.sin_two_mul]]
      rw [h2]
      norm_num
    contradiction
  have htan : Real.tan x = Real.sin x / Real.cos x := by
    rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]

theorem algebra_186130 : (Real.cos (34 * Real.pi / 180))^(-1 : ℤ) +
    (Real.tan (56 * Real.pi / 180))^(-1 : ℤ) =

    have h2 : 34 * Real.pi / 180 = Real.pi / 2 - 56 * Real.pi / 180 := by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    rw [h2]
    rw [show Real.cos (Real.pi / 2 - 56 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) by
      rw [Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub]

  have h2 : (Real.cos (34 * Real.pi / 180))^(-1 : ℤ) = 1 / Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    rw [h1]
    field_simp
  have h3 : (Real.tan (56 * Real.pi / 180))^(-1 : ℤ) = Real.cos (56 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    have htan : Real.tan (56 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.cos (56 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    rw [htan]
    field_simp
  rw [h2, h3]
  have h4 : 56 * Real.pi / 180 = 2 * (28 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    ring_nf
  have h5 : 1 + Real.cos (56 * Real.pi / 180) = 2 * Real.cos (28 * Real.pi / 180) ^ 2 := by
    have h3 : 56 * Real.pi / 180 = 2 * (28 * Real.pi / 180) := by

  have h6 : Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) = 2 * Real.sin (28 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (28 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    have h3 : 56 * Real.pi / 180 = 2 * (28 * Real.pi / 180) := by
      ring_nf
    rw [h3]
    rw [show Real.sin (2 * (28 * Real.pi / 180)) = 2 * Real.sin (28 * Real.pi / 180) * Real.cos (28 * Real.pi / 180) by
      rw [Real.sin_two_mul]
    ]
  have htan_eq : Real.tan (28 * Real.pi / 180) = Real.sin (28 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.cos (28 * Real.pi / 180) := by
    rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  have h9 : Real.sin (28 * Real.pi / 180) ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : 0 < 28 * Real.pi / 180 := by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have h2 : Real.sin (28 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := by

      all_goals linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    linarith
  have h8 : Real.cos (28 * Real.pi / 180) ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : 0 < 28 * Real.pi / 180 := by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have h2 : Real.cos (28 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := by
      apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
      constructor
      · linarith [Real.pi_pos]
      · linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    linarith
  have eq1 : (1 / Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) + Real.cos (56 * Real.pi / 180) / Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180)) =

    have h9' : Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) ≠ 0 := by
      have h4 : 0 < 56 * Real.pi / 180 := by
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      have h5 : Real.sin (56 * Real.pi / 180) > 0 := by
        apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
        all_goals
        linarith [Real.pi_pos]
      linarith
    field_simp [h9']
    <;> ring
  rw [eq1]
  rw [htan_eq]
  rw [h5, h6]
  field_simp [h9, h8]
  <;> ring_nf

        omega

/- Let $x$ be a non-zero real number such that $x+\frac{1}{x}$ is an integer. Show that for all $n \in \mathbb{N}, x^{n}+\frac{1}{x^{n}}$ is an integer. -/
theorem algebra_103350 {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (h : ∃ n : ℤ, x + 1 / x = n) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℤ, x ^ n + 1 / x ^ n = m := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_103350 {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (h : ∃ n : ℤ, x + 1 / x = n) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℤ, x ^ n + 1 / x ^ n = m := by
  intro n
  have h2 : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ m : ℤ, x ^ n + 1 / x ^ n = m := by
    intro n
    induction' n using Nat.strongRecOn with n ih
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      use 2
      field_simp at *
      <;> norm_num
      <;> nlinarith
    | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        rcases h with ⟨n₀, hn⟩
        use n₀
        field_simp at hn ⊢
        <;> nlinarith
      | succ n =>
        have h₁ := ih (n) (by linarith)
        have h₂ := ih (n + 1) (by linarith)
        rcases h₁ with ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩
        rcases h₂ with ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩
        rcases h with ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩
        use n₀ * m₂ - m₁
        have h3 : x ^ (n + 2) + 1 / x ^ (n + 2) = (x + 1 / x) * (x ^ (n + 1) + 1 / x ^ (n + 1)) - (x ^ n + 1 / x ^ n) := by
          field_simp
          <;> ring
        rw [h3, hn₀, hm₂, hm₁]
        all_goals norm_num
        all_goals nlinarith
  specialize h2 n
  simpa using h2

/- 2.175. $\frac{\sqrt{x-2 \sqrt{x-1}}}{\sqrt{x-1}-1}$. -/
theorem algebra_159287 {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hf : ∀ x, f x = sqrt (x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1)) / (sqrt (x - 1) - 1)) :
  ∀ x, (x ∈ Ico 1 2 → f x = -1) ∧ (x > 2 → f x = 1) :=
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem algebra_159287 {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hf : ∀ x, f x = sqrt (x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1)) / (sqrt (x - 1) - 1)) :
  ∀ x, (x ∈ Ico 1 2 → f x = -1) ∧ (x > 2 → f x = 1) := by
  intro x 
  constructor 
  · -- First, prove that if x ∈ [1, 2) then f x = -1
    intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    have h1 : 1 ≤ x := hx1
    have h2 : x < 2 := hx2
    have h3 : 0 ≤ x - 1 := by linarith
    have h4 : x - 1 < 1 := by nlinarith 
    have h5 : sqrt (x - 1) < 1 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x - 1), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (x - 1 : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
    have h6 : sqrt (x - 1) - 1 < 0 := by 
      linarith 
    have h7 : f x = sqrt (x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1)) / (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) := hf x 
    rw [h7] 
    have h8 : x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1) = (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) ^ 2 := by 
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x - 1), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (x - 1 : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
    have h9 : sqrt (x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1)) = abs (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) := by
      rw [h8]
      have : sqrt ((sqrt (x - 1) - 1) ^ 2) = abs (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) := by 
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
      exact this
    rw [h9] 
    have h10 : sqrt (x - 1) - 1 < 0 := h6 
    have h11 : abs (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) = - (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) := by 
      rw [abs_of_neg h10]
    rw [h11] 
    field_simp [(show sqrt (x - 1) - 1 ≠ 0 by 
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x - 1), h5]
    )]
  · -- Now prove that if x > 2, then f x = 1
    intro hx 
    have h1 : x > 2 := hx 
    have h2 : x - 1 > 1 := by linarith 
    have h3 : sqrt (x - 1) > 1 := by 
      have : sqrt (x - 1) > sqrt (1 : ℝ) := by 
        apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt 
        all_goals linarith 
      have h4 : sqrt (1 : ℝ) = 1 := Real.sqrt_one 
      linarith 
    have h4 : sqrt (x - 1) - 1 > 0 := by 
      linarith [h3] 
    have h7 : f x = sqrt (x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1)) / (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) := hf x 
    rw [h7] 
    have h8 : x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1) = (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) ^ 2 := by 
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x - 1), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (x - 1 : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
    have h9 : sqrt (x - 2 * sqrt (x - 1)) = abs (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) := by 
      rw [h8] 
      have : sqrt ((sqrt (x - 1) - 1) ^ 2) = abs (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) := by 
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs] 
      exact this 
    rw [h9] 
    have h10 : sqrt (x - 1) - 1 > 0 := h4 
    have h11 : abs (sqrt (x - 1) - 1) = sqrt (x - 1) - 1 := by 
      rw [abs_of_pos h10] 
    rw [h11] 
    field_simp [(show sqrt (x - 1) - 1 ≠ 0 by 
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x - 1), h3]
    )]

When does equality hold? -/
theorem inequalities_233378 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)

theorem inequalities_233378 (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h : a + b + c = 1) :

  have h1 : 0 < a * b * c := by

    apply mul_pos
    exact ha
    exact hb
    exact hc

/- 879. Solve the equation in natural numbers

$$
x!+12=y^{2}
$$ -/
theorem number_theory_115341 (x y : ℕ) :
    Nat.factorial x + 12 = y^2 ↔ (x = 4 ∧ y = 6) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem number_theory_115341 (x y : ℕ) :
    Nat.factorial x + 12 = y^2 ↔ (x = 4 ∧ y = 6) := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume Nat.factorial x + 12 = y^2, prove (x = 4 ∧ y = 6)
    intro h
    by_cases h1 : x ≤ 6
    · -- x ≤ 6
      interval_cases x <;> try { 
        simp [Nat.factorial] at h 
        all_goals 
          have : y ≤ 32 := by nlinarith 
          interval_cases y <;> omega 
      }
    · -- x > 6 
      have h2 : x ≥ 7 := by omega 
      have h3 : 5 ∣ Nat.factorial x := by 
        apply Nat.dvd_factorial 
        all_goals omega 
      have h4 : y^2 % 5 = 0 ∨ y^2 % 5 = 1 ∨ y^2 % 5 = 4 := by 
        have h1 : y % 5 = 0 ∨ y % 5 = 1 ∨ y % 5 = 2 ∨ y % 5 = 3 ∨ y % 5 = 4 := by 
          omega 
        rcases h1 with (h1 | h1 | h1 | h1 | h1) 
        · -- y % 5 = 0 
          simp [Nat.pow_mod, h1] 
        · -- y % 5 = 1 
          simp [Nat.pow_mod, h1] 
        · -- y % 5 = 2 
          simp [Nat.pow_mod, h1] 
        · -- y % 5 = 3 
          simp [Nat.pow_mod, h1] 
        · -- y % 5 = 4 
          simp [Nat.pow_mod, h1] 
      have h5 : (Nat.factorial x + 12) % 5 = 2 := by 
        have h5 : Nat.factorial x % 5 = 0 := by 
          have h5 : x ≥ 5 := by omega 
          have h6 : 5 ∣ Nat.factorial x := by 
            apply Nat.dvd_factorial 
            all_goals omega 
          omega 
        omega 
      have h6 : y^2 % 5 = 2 := by 
        omega 
      omega 
  · -- Assume (x = 4 ∧ y = 6), prove Nat.factorial x + 12 = y^2 
    rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩ 
    rw [hx, hy] 
    norm_num [Nat.factorial]

/- Find all values of $k$ for which the system

x + ky - z &= 0, \\
kx - y - z &= 0, \\

theorem calculus_18703 (k : ℝ) :
    ∃ x y z : ℝ, (x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 ∨ z ≠ 0) ∧
      x + k * y - z = 0 ∧ k * x - y - z = 0 ∧ x + y - k * z = 0 ↔

formal_proof:

theorem calculus_18703 (k : ℝ) :
    ∃ x y z : ℝ, (x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 ∨ z ≠ 0) ∧
      x + k * y - z = 0 ∧ k * x - y - z = 0 ∧ x + y - k * z = 0 ↔
    k = -1 ∨ k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := by
  by_cases h1 : k = -1
  · -- If k = -1, use the solution (0, 1, -1)

  have h4 : x + y = 5 ∨ x + y = -5 := by
    have h5 : (x + y) ^ 2 - 25 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have h6 : (x + y - 5) * (x + y + 5) = 0 := by

    cases (mul_eq_zero.1 h6) with

    6 ∣ d := by

  have h8 : d % 2 = 0 := by 
    have hp2 : p % 2 = 1 := by

    have h12 : (p + d) % 2 = 1 := by
      have h6 : q = p + d := by linarith [hqr]

    omega

    have hp2 : p % 3 = 1 ∨ p % 3 = 2 := by

      · right; exact h10

    · -- p ≡ 1 (mod 3)
      have hq1 : q % 3 = 1 ∨ q % 3 = 2 := by
        have h10 : q % 3 = 0 ∨ q % 3 = 1 ∨ q % 3 = 2 := by omega

theorem algebra_198059 (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)

theorem algebra_198059 (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hxy : x * y = 1) (hxi : (x * 1.1) * y * (1 - d / 100) = 1) :

    field_simp [(show x ≠ 0 by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  rw [hy_eq] at hxi
  have hx1 : x ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have eq1 : (x * 1.1) * (1 / x) * (1 - d / 100) = 1.1 * (1 - d / 100) := by
    field_simp [hx1]
    <;> ring_nf
  rw [eq1] at hxi
  ring_nf at hxi
  field_simp [(show (11 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)] at hxi ⊢
  nlinarith

\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 10
\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 21
\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 32
\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 36
$ -/
theorem calculus_36604 : ⌊(1 + (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 4) / (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 6 + sqrt 8 + 4)) ^ 10⌋ = 32 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem calculus_36604 : ⌊(1 + (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 4) / (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 6 + sqrt 8 + 4)) ^ 10⌋ = 32 := by

  have h1 : sqrt 4 = 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_mul_self_eq] <;> norm_num

  have h2 : sqrt 8 = 2 * sqrt 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_mul_self_eq] <;> norm_num
    <;> ring_nf 
    <;> norm_num

  have h11 : (1 + (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 4) / (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 6 + sqrt 8 + 4)) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [h1, h2]
    have h14 : Real.sqrt 6 = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 3 := by
      have h23 : Real.sqrt 6 = Real.sqrt (2 * 3: ℝ) := by
        norm_num
      rw [h23]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num)]
    rw [h14]
    field_simp [(show Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 by positivity), (show Real.sqrt 3 ≠ 0 by positivity)]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ)), Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < (3 : ℝ)), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) by norm_num), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt 2 - 1), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt 3 - 1), mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2) (Real.sqrt_nonneg 3)]
  
  have h43 : (1 + (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 4) / (sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 6 + sqrt 8 + 4)) ^ 10 = (32 : ℝ) := by
    rw [h11]
    have h51 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) by norm_num)
    calc
      Real.sqrt 2 ^ 10 = (Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2) ^ 5 := by ring
      _ = (2) ^ 5 := by rw [h51]
      _ = (32 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  
  rw [h43]
  all_goals norm_num

/- 420. Prove that for $a>0, a \neq 1$
1) $\log _{a^{2}} P=\frac{\log _{a} P}{2}$
2) $\log _{\sqrt{a}} P=2 \log _{a} P$
3) $\log _{\frac{1}{a}} P=-\log _{a} P$. -/
theorem algebra_278293 {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a ∧ a ≠ 1) (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    logb (a^2) P = logb a P / 2 ∧ logb (sqrt a) P = 2 * logb a P ∧
    logb (1 / a) P = -logb a P := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem algebra_278293 {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a ∧ a ≠ 1) (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) :
    logb (a^2) P = logb a P / 2 ∧ logb (sqrt a) P = 2 * logb a P ∧
    logb (1 / a) P = -logb a P := by
  have ha1 : 0 < a := ha.1
  have ha2 : a ≠ 1 := ha.2

  constructor
  · -- We need to prove that $\log_{a^2} P = \frac{\log_a P}{2}$
    have h1 : logb (a^2) P = logb a P / 2 := by
      have h2 : logb (a ^ 2) P = (log P) / (log (a ^ 2)) := by
        field_simp [logb]
      have h3 : log (a ^ 2) = 2 * log a := by
        simp [log_pow]
      have h4 : logb a P = (log P) / (log a) := by
        field_simp [logb]
      rw [h2, h3, h4]
      <;> field_simp <;> ring
    exact h1
  constructor
  · -- We need to prove that $\log_{\sqrt{a}} P = 2 \log_a P$
    have h2 : logb (sqrt a) P = 2 * logb a P := by
      have h5 : logb (sqrt a) P = (log P) / (log (sqrt a)) := by
        field_simp [logb]
      have h6 : log (sqrt a) = (1 / 2) * log a := by
        have h7 : sqrt a = a ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
        rw [h7]
        have h8 : log (a ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * log a := by
          rw [log_rpow]
          all_goals linarith
        linarith
      have h7 : logb a P = (log P) / (log a) := by
        field_simp [logb]
      rw [h5, h6, h7]
      <;> field_simp <;> ring_nf
    exact h2
  · -- We need to prove that $\log_{\frac{1}{a}} P = -\log_a P$
    have h3 : logb (1 / a) P = -logb a P := by
      have h8 : logb (1 / a) P = (log P) / (log (1 / a)) := by
        field_simp [logb]
      have h9 : log (1 / a) = -log a := by
        simp [log_div, log_one]
      have h10 : logb a P = (log P) / (log a) := by
        field_simp [logb]
      rw [h8, h9, h10]
      <;> field_simp <;> ring_nf
    exact h3

Prove: For any $m, n \in M$, we have $m n \in M$. -/
theorem number_theory_298599 (b c : ℤ) (M : Set ℤ) (hM : M = {x^2 + b * x * y + c * y^2 | (x : ℤ) (y : ℤ)}) :

theorem number_theory_298599 (b c : ℤ) (M : Set ℤ) (hM : M = {x^2 + b * x * y + c * y^2 | (x : ℤ) (y : ℤ)}) :
    ∀ m ∈ M, ∀ n ∈ M, m * n ∈ M := by

formal_proof:

theorem algebra_10560 : round (Real.logb 7 2400 : ℝ) = 4 := by

  have h1 : 3.5 < Real.logb 7 2400 := by
    have h2400 : Real.logb 7 2400 = Real.log 2400 / Real.log 7 := by
      field_simp [Real.logb]
    rw [h2400]
    have h3 : Real.log 2400 > 3.5 * Real.log 7 := by
      have h4 : Real.log 343 = 3 * Real.log 7 := by
        have h5 : (343 : ℝ) = (7: ℝ) ^ 3 := by norm_num
        rw [h5]
        have h6 : Real.log ((7 : ℝ) ^ 3) = (3 : ℝ) * Real.log 7 := by
          simp [Real.log_pow]
        linarith
      have h5 : Real.log (343 : ℝ) = 3 * Real.log 7 := h4
      have h6 : Real.log (343 * Real.sqrt 7) = Real.log 343 + Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      have h7 : Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 7 := by
        have h8 : Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 7 := by
          have h9 : Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) = Real.log ((7 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
            rw [show Real.sqrt 7 = (7 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) by
              rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]]
          rw [h9]
          rw [Real.log_rpow]
          all_goals norm_num
          all_goals norm_num
          all_goals norm_num
        linarith
      have h8 : Real.log (343 * Real.sqrt 7) = 3.5 * Real.log 7 := by
        rw [h6]
        rw [h5, h7]
        all_goals ring_nf
      have h5_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt 7 := by positivity
      have h6_pos : 0 < (343 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 7 := by positivity
      have h7_pos : (343 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 7 < (2400 : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 7, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (7 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 7]
      have h9 : Real.log 2400 > Real.log (343 * Real.sqrt 7) := by
        apply Real.log_lt_log
        all_goals nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 7, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (7 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 7]
      linarith [h8, h9]
    have h3_pos : 0 < Real.log 7 := by
      apply Real.log_pos
      all_goals norm_num
    have h4 : Real.log 2400 / Real.log 7 > 3.5 := by
      apply (lt_div_iff' (by positivity)).mpr
      linarith
    linarith

  have h2 : Real.logb 7 2400 < (4.5 : ℝ) := by
    have h2400 : Real.logb 7 2400 = Real.log 2400 / Real.log 7 := by
      field_simp [Real.logb]
    rw [h2400]
    have h3 : Real.log 2400 < 4.5 * Real.log 7 := by
      have h4 : Real.log (2401 : ℝ) = 4 * Real.log 7 := by
        have h5 : (2401 : ℝ) = (7 : ℝ) ^ 4 := by norm_num
        rw [h5]
        have h6 : Real.log ((7 : ℝ) ^ 4) = (4 : ℝ) * Real.log 7 := by

      have h5 : 0 < Real.sqrt 7 := by positivity
      have h6_pos : 0 < (2401 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 7 := by positivity
      have h7_pos : (2400 : ℝ) < (2401 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 7 := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 7, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (7 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 7, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (7 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      have h8 : Real.log (2401 * Real.sqrt 7) = 4.5 * Real.log 7 := by
        have h9 : Real.log (2401 * Real.sqrt 7) = Real.log 2401 + Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        have h10 : Real.log (2401 : ℝ) = 4 * Real.log 7 := h4
        have h11 : Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 7 := by
          have h12 : Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 7 := by
            have h13 : Real.log (Real.sqrt 7) = Real.log ((7 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by

                rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]]
            rw [h13]
            rw [Real.log_rpow]

            all_goals norm_num

        apply Real.log_lt_log
        all_goals nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 7, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (7 : ℝ) by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 7]

    have h4_pos : 0 < Real.log 7 := by
      apply Real.log_pos
      all_goals norm_num
    have h4 : Real.log 2400 / Real.log 7 < 4.5 := by
      apply (div_lt_iff' (by positivity)).mpr

$\mathrm{(A)}\ 0 \qquad\mathrm{(B)}\ 1 \qquad\mathrm{(C)}\ 2  \qquad\mathrm{(D)}\ 4 \qquad\mathrm{(E)}\ 8$ -/
theorem algebra_96883 {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ∀ z, f z = I * (z.1 - I * z.2)) :

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem algebra_96883 {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : ∀ z, f z = I * (z.1 - I * z.2)) :
    {z | ‖z‖ = 5 ∧ f z = z}.ncard = 2 := by
  have h1 : {z | ‖z‖ = 5 ∧ f z = z} = {(5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) + (5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) * I, - (5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) - (5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) * I} := by
    ext z
    simp only [hf, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.union_insert, Set.union_singleton]
    constructor
    · -- First, we'll prove the forward implication: if z is in the intersection of {z | ‖z‖ = 5} and {z | f z = z}, then z must be one of the two complex solutions we found earlier.
      intro h
      rcases h with ⟨habs, heq⟩
      have h_eq_1 : z.re = z.im := by
        simp [Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, 
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im] at heq ⊢
        <;> norm_num at heq ⊢
        <;> nlinarith
      have h_eq_2 : (z.re) ^ 2 + (z.im) ^ 2 = 25 := by
        have h1 : ‖z‖ = 5 := habs
        have h7 : ‖z‖ = Real.sqrt (z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2) := by
          simp [Complex.norm_eq_abs, Complex.abs, Complex.normSq]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> simp [Complex.normSq]
          <;> norm_num
          <;> all_goals ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
          <;> all_goals tauto
        rw [h7] at h1
        have h25 : (z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 : ℝ) = 25 := by
          calc
            (z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 : ℝ) = (Real.sqrt (z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt]; all_goals nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z.re), sq_nonneg (z.im), sq_nonneg (z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)]
            _ = (5) ^ 2 := by rw [h1]
            _ = (25 : ℝ) := by norm_num
        nlinarith
      rw [show z.im = z.re from by linarith [h_eq_1]] at h_eq_2
      have h_eq_3 : (z.re) ^ 2 = 25 / 2 := by
        nlinarith
      have h_eq_4 : z.re = Real.sqrt (25 / 2) ∨ z.re = - Real.sqrt (25 / 2) := by
        have h1 : (z.re) ^ 2 = 25 / 2 := h_eq_3
        have : (z.re - Real.sqrt (25 / 2)) * (z.re + Real.sqrt (25 / 2)) = 0 := by
          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (25 / 2 : ℝ) > 0), Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (25 / 2 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
        cases' (mul_eq_zero.1 this) with h2 h3
        · -- Case z.re = sqrt(25 / 2)
          left
          linarith
        · -- Case z.re = -sqrt(25 / 2)
          right
          linarith
      have h2 : Real.sqrt (25 / 2) = (5 * Real.sqrt 2) / 2 := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> norm_num
        <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
        all_goals nlinarith
      cases h_eq_4 with
      | inl h_eq_5 =>
        have h_eq_6 : z.re = (5 * Real.sqrt 2) / 2 := by
          rw [h2] at h_eq_5
          linarith
        have h_eq_7 : z.im = (5 * Real.sqrt 2) / 2 := by
          linarith [h_eq_1, h_eq_6]
        simp [Complex.ext_iff, h_eq_6, h_eq_7]
        <;> norm_num
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num
        all_goals ring_nf <;> norm_num
      | inr h_eq_5 =>
        have h_eq_6 : z.re = - (5 * Real.sqrt 2) / 2 := by
          have h_eq_neg : z.re = - Real.sqrt (25 / 2) := by
            tauto
          rw [h_eq_neg]
          rw [h2]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
          all_goals nlinarith
          all_goals tauto
        have h_eq_7 : z.im = - (5 * Real.sqrt 2) / 2 := by
          linarith [h_eq_1, h_eq_6]
        simp [Complex.ext_iff, h_eq_6, h_eq_7]
        <;> norm_num
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num
        all_goals ring_nf <;> norm_num
    · -- We'll now prove the reverse iimplication: both of these complex numbers satisfy our conditions.
      rintro (h_eq | h_eq)
      · -- First case: z = 5 * sqrt(2)/2 + 5 * sqrt(2)/2 * i
        rw [h_eq]
        constructor
        · -- Verify that |z| = 5
          have h7 : ‖( (5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) + (5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) * I )‖ = 5 := by
            simp [Complex.norm_eq_abs, Complex.abs, Complex.normSq]
            rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> norm_num
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> norm_num
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]

            all_goals nlinarith

          all_goals norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]
          all_goals ring_nf <;> norm_num
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num
        all_goals ring_nf
        all_goals norm_num
      · -- Second case: z = -5 * sqrt(2)/2 - 5 * sqrt(2)/2 * i
        rw [h_eq]
        constructor
        · -- Verify that |z| = 5
          have h7 : ‖(- (5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) - (5 * Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) * I)‖ = 5 := by
            simp [Complex.norm_eq_abs, Complex.abs, Complex.normSq]
            rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_sq_eq] <;> norm_num
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> norm_num
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]
            all_goals norm_num
            all_goals nlinarith
          tauto
        · -- Verify that f z = z
          simp [Complex.ext_iff, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_add, mul_assoc, pow_two]
          all_goals norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr, Real.sqrt_nonneg, Real.sq_sqrt, pow_two]
          all_goals ring_nf <;> norm_num
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
          all_goals ring_nf
          all_goals norm_num

    -- Show that these two complex numbers are different

theorem number_theory_81323 (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n ∧ n ≥ 3) (a : Fin n → ℝ)

  -- Calculate z^3 = i

    _ = (1) ^ 168 := by 
      rw [h3]
    _ = 1 := by

    have h2 : 1 + ((x ^ 2 - 1) / (2 * x)) ^ 2 = ((x ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2) / (4 * x ^ 2) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : sqrt (((x ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2) / (4 * x ^ 2)) = (x ^ 2 + 1) / (2 * |x|) := by
      have h4 : sqrt (((x ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2) / (4 * x ^ 2)) = sqrt ((x ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2) / sqrt (4 * x ^ 2) := by

            nlinarith

        rw [Real.sqrt_sq (show 0 ≤ x ^ 2 + 1 by positivity)]

          rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
        rw [h7, h8, h9]

    have h4 : x ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have h11 : x ^ 2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg x
      nlinarith
    field_simp [h4, hx]

  rw [h2]

    have h3 : |x| = -x := abs_of_neg h

    have : w = -v := by linarith

theorem number_theory_310392 (x y : ℕ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)

    have h3 : x ≥ 4 := by linarith

    ∀ x, f x = (-x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1) / (x ^ 2 - x + 1) := by
formal_proof:

theorem algebra_254966 (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∀ x, f x + x * f (1 - x) = x ^ 2 - 1) ↔
    ∀ x, f x = (-x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1) / (x ^ 2 - x + 1) := by

  constructor
  · -- Assume that ∀ x, f x + x * f (1 - x) = x ^ 2 - 1, prove ∀ x, f x = (-x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1) / (x ^ 2 - x + 1)
    intro h
    intro x
    have eq1 := h x
    have eq2 := h (1 - x)
    have eq3 : f x + x * f (1 - x) = x ^ 2 - 1 := by
      simpa using eq1
    have eq4 : f (1 - x) + (1 - x) * f x = (1 - x) ^ 2 - 1 := by
      have eq5 : 1 - (1 - x) = x := by
        ring
      rw [eq5] at eq2
      linarith [eq2]

    have eq5 : f x = (-x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1) / (x ^ 2 - x + 1) := by
      have h6 : x ^ 2 - x + 1 ≠ 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 1 / 2), sq_nonneg (x - 2)]
      have h11 : f x * (x^2 - x + 1) = -x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1 := by
        nlinarith [eq3, eq4]
      have h12 : f x = (-x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1) / (x ^ 2 - x + 1) := by
        field_simp [h6]
        linarith [h11]
      exact h12
    exact eq5
  · -- Assume that ∀ x, f x = (-x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1) / (x ^ 2 - x + 1), prove ∀ x, f x + x * f (1 - x) = x ^ 2 - 1
    intro h x
    have h1 : f x = (-x ^ 3 + 3 * x ^ 2 - 1) / (x ^ 2 - x + 1) := h x
    have h2 : f (1 - x) = (-(1 - x) ^ 3 + 3 * (1 - x) ^ 2 - 1) / ((1 - x) ^ 2 - (1 - x) + 1) := h (1 - x)
    rw [h1, h2]
    have h3 : (x ^ 2 - x + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 1 / 2), sq_nonneg (x - 2)]
    have h4 : ((1 - x) ^ 2 - (1 - x) + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((1 - x) - 1 / 2), sq_nonneg ((1 - x) - 2)]
    field_simp [h3, h4]
    ring

theorem algebra_152109 (x y z α : ℝ) 
    (h₀ : α = Real.arccos (1 / 9))

theorem algebra_152109 (x y z α : ℝ)

    (h₂ : z - y = α) 
    (h₃ : (5 + Real.cos y) ^ 2 = (5 + Real.cos x) * (5 + Real.cos z) ∧ 5 + Real.cos x ≠ 5 + Real.cos y ∧ 5 + Real.cos y ≠ 5 + Real.cos z ∧ 5 + Real.cos x ≠ 5 + Real.cos z):
    Real.cos y = -1 / 9 := by
  rcases h₃ with ⟨h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇⟩
  have h8 : x = y - α := by linarith
  have h9 : z = y + α := by linarith

  have h10 : Real.cos x = Real.cos y * Real.cos α + Real.sin y * Real.sin α := by
    rw [show x = y - α by linarith]
    rw [Real.cos_sub]
  have h11 : Real.cos z = Real.cos y * Real.cos α - Real.sin y * Real.sin α := by
    rw [show z = y + α by linarith]
    rw [Real.cos_add]
  have h12 : Real.cos α = 1 / 9 := by
    rw [h₀]
    have h12 : Real.cos (Real.arccos (1 / 9)) = 1 / 9 := by
      apply Real.cos_arccos
      all_goals norm_num
    linarith
  have h13 : Real.sin α ^ 2 = 80 / 81 := by
    have h14 : Real.sin α ^ 2 + Real.cos α ^ 2 = 1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq α
    rw [h12] at h14
    nlinarith
  have h15 : Real.sin α ≥ 0 := by
    have hα : 0 ≤ α := by
      rw [h₀]
      apply Real.arccos_nonneg
    have hα2 : α ≤ Real.pi := by
      rw [h₀]
      apply Real.arccos_le_pi
    have h16 : 0 ≤ Real.sin α := by
      apply Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi
      all_goals linarith [hα, hα2]
    linarith
  have h14 : Real.sin α = 4 * Real.sqrt 5 / 9 := by
    have h17 : Real.sin α ^ 2 = 80 / 81 := h13
    have h18 : Real.sin α ≥ 0 := h15
    have hsinα_eq : Real.sin α = Real.sqrt (80 / 81) := by

      have h21 : Real.sin α = Real.sqrt (Real.sin α ^ 2) := by

      <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num

/- Solve the system of equations

$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
a^{3}+3 a b^{2}+3 a c^{2}-6 a b c=1 \\
b^{3}+3 b a^{2}+3 b c^{2}-6 a b c=1 \\
c^{3}+3 c a^{2}+3 c b^{2}-6 a b c=1
\end{array}\right.

in real numbers.

Answer: $a=1, b=1, c=1$. -/
theorem algebra_236512 {a b c : ℝ} (h1 : a^3 + 3 * a * b^2 + 3 * a * c^2 - 6 * a * b * c = 1)
(h2 : b^3 + 3 * b * a^2 + 3 * b * c^2 - 6 * a * b * c = 1) (h3 : c^3 + 3 * c * a^2 + 3 * c * b^2 - 6 * a * b * c = 1) :
(a, b, c) = (1, 1, 1) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_236512 {a b c : ℝ} (h1 : a^3 + 3 * a * b^2 + 3 * a * c^2 - 6 * a * b * c = 1)
(h2 : b^3 + 3 * b * a^2 + 3 * b * c^2 - 6 * a * b * c = 1) (h3 : c^3 + 3 * c * a^2 + 3 * c * b^2 - 6 * a * b * c = 1) :
(a, b, c) = (1, 1, 1) := by
  have h4 : (a - b) * ((a - b) ^ 2 + 3 * c ^ 2) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c)]
  have h5 : (b - c) * ((b - c) ^ 2 + 3 * a ^ 2) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (a - c), sq_nonneg (b - c)]
  cases (mul_eq_zero.mp h4) with
  | inl h4 =>
    have hab : a = b := by linarith
    cases (mul_eq_zero.mp h5) with
    | inl h5 =>
      have hbc : b = c := by linarith
      have hac : a = c := by linarith [hab, hbc]
      have ha1 : a = 1 := by
        have h1' : a^3 = 1 := by
          rw [show b = a by linarith [hab], show c = a by linarith [hac]] at h1
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (a^2 - 1)]
        have h1 : a^3 - 1 = 0 := by linarith
        have h1 : (a - 1) * (a^2 + a + 1) = 0 := by
          nlinarith
        cases (mul_eq_zero.mp h1) with
        | inl h1 =>
          linarith
        | inr h1 =>
          have h2 : a^2 + a + 1 = 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + 1 / 2)]
      have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith [hab, ha1]
      have hc1 : c = 1 := by linarith [hac, ha1]
      simp [ha1, hb1, hc1]
    | inr h5 =>
      have h5' : (b - c) ^ 2 + 3 * a ^ 2 = 0 := by
        linarith
      have hbc : b = c := by

    have hab : a = b := by

    have hc0 : c = 0 := by

theorem algebra_306038 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)

    c * (1 / a + 1 / b) = -3) :
    a + b + c = 1 ∨ a + b + c = -1 ∨ a + b + c = 0 := by

  have eq1 : a * (1 / b + 1 / c) + b * (1 / c + 1 / a) + c * (1 / a + 1 / b) = 
    (a * (b + c) ) / (b * c) + (b * (a + c) ) / (a * c) + (c * (a + b) ) / (a * b) := by 
    field_simp [hb, hc, ha]
    <;> ring

  have eq2 : (a * (b + c) ) / (b * c) + (b * (a + c) ) / (a * c) + (c * (a + b) ) / (a * b) = -3 := by 
    linarith [h2, eq1]

  have eq3 : a^2 * (b + c) + b^2 * (a + c) + c^2 * (a + b) + 3 * a * b * c = 0 := by
    have h3 : a * b * c ≠ 0 := by
      apply mul_ne_zero 
      apply mul_ne_zero 
      exact ha 
      exact hb 
      exact hc

      ( a^2 * (b + c) + b^2 * (a + c) + c^2 * (a + b) ) / (a * b * c) := by

        apply mul_ne_zero hb hc, show a * c ≠ 0 by
          apply mul_ne_zero ha hc, show a * b ≠ 0 by
            apply mul_ne_zero ha hb ]
      ring 
    rw [eq4] at eq2
    field_simp [h3] at eq2 ⊢ 
    nlinarith 

  have eq4 : (a + b + c) * (a * b + b * c + c * a) = 0 := by 
    nlinarith [eq3]

  cases (mul_eq_zero.mp eq4) with
  | inl h3 =>
    right 
    right 
    linarith 
  | inr h4 =>
    have h5 : (a + b + c)^2 = 1 := by 
      nlinarith [h1, h4]

      have : a + b + c = 1 ∨ a + b + c = -1 := by 
        rw [sq_eq_one_iff] at h 
        tauto 
      assumption

    cases h6 with
    | inl h7 =>
      left 
      linarith
    | inr h8 =>

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem algebra_253228 {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    logb 10 x = 1 / 2 * logb 10 (x + 1) ↔
    x = (Real.sqrt 5 + 1) / 2 := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume logb 10 x = 1 / 2 * logb 10 (x + 1), prove x = (Real.sqrt 5 + 1) / 2
    intro h
    have h1 : 0 < x + 1 := by linarith
    have h2 : logb 10 (x ^ 2) = logb 10 (x + 1) := by
      have h3 : logb 10 (x ^ 2) = 2 * logb 10 x := by
        simp [logb_pow]
      have h4 : logb 10 (x + 1) = 2 * logb 10 x := by
        linarith [h]
      linarith [h3, h4]
    -- Now that we have the logarithms equal, we can equate the arguments
    have h3 : x ^ 2 = x + 1 := by
      have h4_pos1 : x ^ 2 > 0 := by nlinarith
      have h4_pos2 : x + 1 > 0 := by nlinarith
      have h4_inj1 : x ^ 2 ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
        simp [h4_pos1]
      have h4_inj2 : x + 1 ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
        simp [h4_pos2]
      apply logb_injOn_pos (by norm_num) h4_inj1 h4_inj2 h2
    -- Now we solve the quadratic equation
    have h4 : x ^ 2 - x - 1 = 0 := by 
      linarith
    have h5 : x = (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 := by
      have h6 : x ^ 2 - x - 1 = 0 := h4
      have h7 : x ^ 2 - x - 1 = (x - (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) * (x - (1 - Real.sqrt 5) / 2) := by
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (5 : ℝ) > 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
      rw [h7] at h6
      cases' (mul_eq_zero.1 h6) with h8 h9
      · -- Case where x - (1 + sqrt 5)/2 = 0
        linarith
      · -- Case where x - (1 - sqrt 5)/2 = 0
        have h10 : x = (1 - Real.sqrt 5) / 2 := by
          nlinarith
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (5 : ℝ) > 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
    -- Now need to rewrite to match the goal
    rw [h5]
    ring_nf
  · -- Assume x = (Real.sqrt 5 + 1) / 2, prove logb 10 x = 1 / 2 * logb 10 (x + 1)
    intro h
    have h1 : 0 < x + 1 := by
      rw [h]
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (5 : ℝ) > 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
    have h2 : x ^ 2 = x + 1 := by
      rw [h]
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (show (5 : ℝ) > 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 : ℝ) by norm_num)]
    -- Now we need to show the logarithmic equation
    -- We have x^2 = x + 1, so log(x^2) = log(x + 1)
    -- Also, log(x^2) = 2 * log(x)
    -- Therefore, 2 * log(x) = log(x + 1)
    -- So log(x) = 1/2 * log(x + 1)
    have h_eq : logb 10 x = 1 / 2 * logb 10 (x + 1) := by
    -- We need to show this from the available hypotheses
      have h_eq3 : logb 10 (x ^ 2) = logb 10 (x + 1) := by
        have h_eq4 : x ^ 2 = x + 1 := h2
        rw [h_eq4]
      -- Now that we have the logarithms equal, we can derive the required equality
      have h_eq5 : logb 10 (x ^ 2) = 2 * logb 10 x := by
        simp [logb_pow]
      -- Now we can derive the required equality
      have h3' : (2 * logb 10 x) = logb 10 (x + 1) := by linarith [h_eq3, h_eq5]
      linarith
    exact h_eq

$$
\frac{a}{a+b+d}+\frac{b}{b+c+a}+\frac{c}{c+d+b}+\frac{d}{d+a+c}
$$

can take when $a, b, c, d$ range over the strictly positive real numbers. -/
theorem algebra_125389 (a b c d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x = a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c)) :

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real Set

theorem algebra_125389 (a b c d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x = a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c)) :
    x ∈ Ioo 1 2 := by
  rw [hx]
  constructor
  · -- Prove that the expression is greater than 1
    have h1 : a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c) > 1 := by
      have h2 : 0 < (a + b + d) := by positivity
      have h3 : 0 < (b + c + a) := by positivity
      have h4 : 0 < (c + d + b) := by positivity
      have h5 : 0 < (d + a + c) := by positivity
      have h6 : a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c) - 1 > 0 := by
        have h7 : a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c) - 1 =
            ( a * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) +
              b * (a + b + d) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) +
              c * (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (d + a + c) +
              d * (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) - (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) )
              / ( (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) ) := by
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [h7] at *
        apply div_pos
        · -- Show the numerator is positive
          ring_nf
          nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos ha, sq_pos_of_pos hb, sq_pos_of_pos hc, sq_pos_of_pos hd,
              mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos ha hc, mul_pos ha hd, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hb hd, mul_pos hc hd
          ]
        all_goals
          positivity
      linarith
    linarith
  · -- Prove that the expression is less than 2
    have h2 : a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c) < 2 := by
      have h2 : 0 < (a + b + d) := by positivity
      have h3 : 0 < (b + c + a) := by positivity
      have h4 : 0 < (c + d + b) := by positivity
      have h5 : 0 < (d + a + c) := by positivity
      have h6 : a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c) - 2 < 0 := by
        have h7 : a / (a + b + d) + b / (b + c + a) + c / (c + d + b) + d / (d + a + c) - 2 =
            ( a * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) +
              b * (a + b + d) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) +
              c * (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (d + a + c) +
              d * (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) - 2 * ( (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) ) )
              / ( (a + b + d) * (b + c + a) * (c + d + b) * (d + a + c) ) := by
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [h7] at *
        apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
        · -- Show the numerator is negative
          ring_nf
          nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos ha, sq_pos_of_pos hb, sq_pos_of_pos hc, sq_pos_of_pos hd,
              mul_pos ha hb, mul_pos ha hc, mul_pos ha hd, mul_pos hb hc, mul_pos hb hd, mul_pos hc hd
          ]
        all_goals
          positivity
      linarith
    linarith

import Mathlib

theorem inequalities_600607 (x y : ℝ) (hx : |x| < 1) (hy : |y| < 1) :
    |(x - y) / (1 - x * y)| < 1 := by
  have h1 : -1 < x := by linarith [abs_lt.mp hx]
  have h2 : x < 1 := by linarith [abs_lt.mp hx]
  have h3 : -1 < y := by linarith [abs_lt.mp hy]
  have h4 : y < 1 := by linarith [abs_lt.mp hy]

  have h5 : 0 < 1 - x * y := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x * y - x - y + 1), sq_nonneg (x - 1), sq_nonneg (y - 1)]
  
  have h6 : -1 < (x - y) / (1 - x * y) := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ h5).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - x > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - y > 0)), 
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : x + 1 > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : y + 1 > 0)), 
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - x > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : x + 1 > 0)), 
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - y > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : y + 1 > 0))
    ]
  
  have h7 : (x - y) / (1 - x * y) < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ h5).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - x > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - y > 0)), 
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : x + 1 > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : y + 1 > 0)), 
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - x > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : x + 1 > 0)), 
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : 1 - y > 0)) (sub_pos.mpr (by linarith : y + 1 > 0))
    ]

  apply abs_lt.mpr
  constructor <;> nlinarith [h6, h7]

/- Let $P(x) = ax^2 + bx + c$ and $Q(x) = -ax^2 + bx + c$, where $ac \neq 0$. Consider the polynomial $P(x)Q(x)$. Determine which of the following statements is true regarding the roots of $P(x)Q(x)$:
A) All its roots are real
B) None of its roots are real
C) At least two of its roots are real
D) Exactly two of its roots are real -/
theorem algebra_3353 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (P Q : ℝ → ℝ) (hP : P = fun x => a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c)
    (hQ : Q = fun x => -a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) :
    ∃ x1 x2 : ℝ, x1 ≠ x2 ∧ P x1 * Q x1 = 0 ∧ P x2 * Q x2 = 0 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_3353 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (P Q : ℝ → ℝ) (hP : P = fun x => a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c)
    (hQ : Q = fun x => -a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) :
    ∃ x1 x2 : ℝ, x1 ≠ x2 ∧ P x1 * Q x1 = 0 ∧ P x2 * Q x2 = 0 := by
  by_cases h : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c > 0
  · -- If b^2 - 4ac > 0, then P(x) has two distinct real roots.
    have h1 : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c > 0 := h
    use (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a),
      (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)
    constructor
    · -- Show x1 ≠ x2
      by_contra h3
      have h2 : (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a) = (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a) := by linarith
      have h3 : (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) = (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) := by
        field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by exact ha] at h2 ⊢
        linarith
      have h4 : Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) = 0 := by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)]
      have h5 : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c = 0 := by
        calc
          b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c = (Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt]; nlinarith
          _ = 0 ^ 2 := by rw [show Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) = (0 : ℝ) by linarith]
          _ = (0 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      linarith
    constructor
    · -- Show P x1 * Q x1 = 0
      have hx1 : P ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) = 0 := by
        rw [hP]
        simp
        field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by exact ha]
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
      have h0 : P ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) * Q ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) = 0 := by
        rw [show P ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) = 0 by exact hx1]
        norm_num
      linarith
    · -- Show P x2 * Q x2 = 0
      have hx2 : P ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) = 0 := by
        rw [hP]
        simp
        field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by exact ha]
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
      have h0 : P ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) * Q ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) = 0 := by
        rw [show P ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)) = 0 by exact hx2]
        norm_num
      linarith
  · -- b^2 - 4ac ≤ 0
    have h2 : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have h3 : b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c > 0 := by
      by_cases h4 : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c < 0
      · -- b^2 - 4ac < 0
        nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero ha, sq_pos_of_ne_zero hc, sq_nonneg (b), sq_nonneg (a * c)]
      · -- b^2 - 4ac = 0
        have h5 : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c = 0 := by linarith
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b), sq_pos_of_ne_zero ha, sq_pos_of_ne_zero hc]
    use (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a)), 
      (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))
    constructor
    · -- Show x1 ≠ x2
      by_contra h3
      have h2 : (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a)) = (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a)) := by linarith
      have h3 : (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) = (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) := by
        field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by exact ha] at h2 ⊢
        linarith
      have h4 : Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c) = 0 := by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)]
      have h5 : b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c = 0 := by
        calc
          b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c = (Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt]; nlinarith
          _ = 0 ^ 2 := by rw [show Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c) = (0 : ℝ) by linarith]
          _ = (0 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      linarith
    constructor
    · -- Show P x1 * Q x1 = 0
      have hx1 : Q ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) = 0 := by
        rw [hQ]
        simp
        field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by exact ha]
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
      have h0 : P ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) * Q ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) = 0 := by
        rw [show Q ((-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) = 0 by exact hx1]
        norm_num
      linarith
    · -- Show P x2 * Q x2 = 0
      have hx2 : Q ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) = 0 := by
        rw [hQ]
        simp
        field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by exact ha]
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
      have h0 : P ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) * Q ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) = 0 := by
        rw [show Q ((-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * a * c)) / (2 * (-a))) = 0 by exact hx2]
        norm_num
      linarith

/-The function $y=\sin (x+φ) (0\leqslant φ\leqslant π)$ is an even function on $\mathbb{R}$. Find the value of $φ$.-/
theorem algebra_9291 {φ : ℝ} (hφ : φ ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
(∀ x, (fun x => Real.sin (x + φ)) (-x)=(fun x => Real.sin (x + φ)) x) ↔ φ = Real.pi / 2 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_9291 {φ : ℝ} (hφ : φ ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
(∀ x, (fun x => Real.sin (x + φ)) (-x)=(fun x => Real.sin (x + φ)) x) ↔ φ = Real.pi / 2 := by
  rcases hφ with ⟨hφ1, hφ2⟩
  constructor
  · -- Forward: if y=sin(x+φ) is even, then φ=π/2
    intro heven
    have h1 := heven (Real.pi / 2)
    have eq1 : Real.sin (- (Real.pi / 2) + φ) = Real.sin (Real.pi / 2 + φ) := by 
      simpa using h1
    have eq2 : Real.sin (- (Real.pi / 2) + φ) = - Real.cos φ := by 
      have h2 : - (Real.pi / 2) + φ = φ - (Real.pi / 2) := by ring 
      rw [h2]
      rw [Real.sin_sub]
      simp [Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
    have eq3 : Real.sin (Real.pi / 2 + φ) = Real.cos φ := by 
      rw [Real.sin_add]
      simp [Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
    rw [eq2, eq3] at eq1
    have h2 : Real.cos φ = 0 := by 
      nlinarith [eq1]
    have h3 : φ = Real.pi / 2 := by
      apply Real.cos_eq_zero_iff.1 at h2
      rcases h2 with ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hk1 : k = 0 := by
        by_cases h4 : k > 0
        · -- k ≥ 1
          have hk2 : k ≥ 1 := by omega 
          have h5 : (k : ℝ) ≥ (1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk2 
          nlinarith [Real.pi_pos, Real.pi_gt_three]
        · -- k ≤ 0 
          by_cases h6 : k < 0
          · -- k ≤ -1 
            have hk3 : k ≤ -1 := by omega 
            have h7 : (k : ℝ) ≤ (-1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk3 
            nlinarith [Real.pi_pos, Real.pi_gt_three]
          · -- k = 0 
            omega 
      rw [hk, show (k : ℝ) = (0 : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hk1] 
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos, Real.pi_gt_three]
    exact h3 
  · -- Backward: if φ=π/2, then y=sin(x+φ) is even
    intro heq
    intro x
    have h4 : φ = Real.pi / 2 := by linarith [heq]
    simp [h4]
    have eq1 : Real.sin ((-x) + Real.pi / 2) = Real.cos x := by
      have h6 : Real.sin ((-x) + Real.pi / 2) = Real.sin (Real.pi / 2 - x) := by 
        ring_nf 
      rw [h6]
      have h7 : Real.sin (Real.pi / 2 - x) = Real.cos x := by 
        rw [Real.sin_pi_div_two_sub]
      rw [h7]
    have eq2 : Real.sin (x + Real.pi / 2) = Real.cos x := by 
      have h6 : Real.sin (x + Real.pi / 2) = Real.sin x * Real.cos (Real.pi / 2) + Real.cos x * Real.sin (Real.pi / 2) := by 
        rw [Real.sin_add]
      rw [h6]
      have h7 : Real.cos (Real.pi / 2) = 0 := Real.cos_pi_div_two
      have h8 : Real.sin (Real.pi / 2) = 1 := Real.sin_pi_div_two
      simp [h7, h8]
    linarith [eq1, eq2]

/- If $\tan \alpha = 8$ and $\tan \beta = 7,$ then find $\tan (\alpha - \beta).$ -/
theorem calculus_10745 (α β : ℝ) (h₀ : tan α = 8) (h₁ : tan β = 7) :
    tan (α - β) = 1 / 57 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem calculus_10745 (α β : ℝ) (h₀ : tan α = 8) (h₁ : tan β = 7) :
    tan (α - β) = 1 / 57 := by 
  have h2 : cos α ≠ 0 := by 
    by_contra h
    have htan : tan α = 0 := by 
      rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
      simp [h]
    rw [htan] at h₀
    all_goals linarith
  have h3 : cos β ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have htan : tan β = 0 := by 
      rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
      simp [h]
    rw [htan] at h₁
    all_goals linarith
  have h4 : sin α = 8 * cos α := by
    have htan : tan α = sin α / cos α := by 
      rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    rw [htan] at h₀
    have hcos : cos α ≠ 0 := h2
    field_simp [hcos] at h₀ ⊢
    linarith
  have h5 : sin β = 7 * cos β := by
    have htan : tan β = sin β / cos β := by 
      rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    rw [htan] at h₁
    have hcos : cos β ≠ 0 := h3
    field_simp [hcos] at h₁ ⊢
    linarith
  have htan : tan (α - β) = sin (α - β) / cos (α - β) := by 
    rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  rw [htan]
  rw [sin_sub, cos_sub]
  have h7 : sin α * cos β - cos α * sin β = cos α * cos β := by
    rw [h4, h5]
    ring_nf
  have h8 : cos α * cos β + sin α * sin β = 57 * (cos α * cos β) := by
    rw [h4, h5]
    ring_nf
  rw [h7, h8]
  have hcos1 : cos α ≠ 0 := h2
  have hcos2 : cos β ≠ 0 := h3
  field_simp [hcos1, hcos2, show cos α * cos β ≠ 0 by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    exact hcos1
    exact hcos2
  ]
  <;> norm_num
  <;> linarith [h₀, h₁, hcos1, hcos2]

/- We define the sequence $\left(F_{n}\right)$ called the Fibonacci sequence as follows: $F_{0}=0$ and $F_{1}=1$ and for all natural $n$:

$$
F_{n+2}=F_{n+1}+F_{n}
$$

Show that for all natural number $n$.

$$
\sum_{k=1}^{n} F_{k}^{2}=F_{n} \cdot F_{n+1}
$$

## Strong Induction -/
theorem algebra_164543 {n : ℕ} :
    ∑ k in Finset.Icc 1 n, (fib k)^2 = fib n * fib (n + 1) := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

def fib (n : ℕ) : ℕ := match n with
| 0 => 0
| 1 => 1
| n + 2 => fib (n + 1) + fib n

theorem algebra_164543 {n : ℕ} :
    ∑ k in Finset.Icc 1 n, (fib k)^2 = fib n * fib (n + 1) := by
  have h1 : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k in Finset.Icc 1 n, (fib k)^2 = fib n * fib (n + 1) := by 
    intro n 
    induction n with 
    | zero => 
      simp [fib]
    | succ n ihn =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
      simp [fib] at ihn ⊢ 
      all_goals try { 
        ring_nf at ihn ⊢ 
        omega 
      }
      all_goals try { 
        nlinarith [ihn]
      }
      all_goals try { 
        induction n with 
        | zero => 
          simp [fib] 
        | succ n ih => 
          simp [fib] at ih ⊢ 
          all_goals try { 
            nlinarith [ih]
          } 
      }
  apply h1 n

theorem algebra_248779 (n : ℕ) :
    ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ (n + 4) +
    ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ (n + 4) +
    ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n +
    ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n = 0 := by

  have h1 : ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = Complex.I := by
    simp [pow_two, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.I_mul_I, Real.sqrt_sq]
    <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num

  have h2 : ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = -Complex.I := by
    simp [pow_two, Complex.ext_iff, Complex.I_mul_I, Real.sqrt_sq]
    <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num

  have h3 : ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 4 = -1 := by
    calc
      ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 4 = (((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = (Complex.I) ^ 2 := by rw [h1]
      _ = -1 := by simp [Complex.I_sq]

  have h4 : ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 4 = -1 := by
    calc
      ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 4 = (((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = (-Complex.I) ^ 2 := by rw [h2]
      _ = -1 := by simp [Complex.I_sq]

  have eq1 : ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ (n + 4) = - ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n := by 
    calc
      ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ (n + 4) = ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n * ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 4 := by 
        ring_nf
      _ = ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n * (-1) := by 
        rw [h3]
      _ = - ((1 + Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n := by 
        ring

  have eq2 : ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ (n + 4) = - ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n := by
    calc
      ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ (n + 4) = ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n * ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 4 := by
        ring_nf
      _ = ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n * (-1) := by 
        rw [h4]
      _ = - ((1 - Complex.I) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ n := by 
        ring

  rw [eq1, eq2]
  ring

/- Simplify the following expression as much as possible:

$$
\left(\frac{\sqrt{1+a}}{\sqrt{1+a}-\sqrt{1-a}}+\frac{1-a}{\sqrt{1-a^{2}}-1+a}\right)\left(\sqrt{\frac{1}{a^{2}}-1}-\frac{1}{a}\right)
$$

where $0<a<1$. -/
theorem algebra_280203 (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a ∧ a < 1) :
    ((Real.sqrt (1 + a)) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a)) +
     (1 - a) / (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a)) *
    (Real.sqrt ((1 / a^2) - 1) - 1 / a) = -1 := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib


theorem algebra_280203 (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a ∧ a < 1) :
    ((Real.sqrt (1 + a)) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a)) +
     (1 - a) / (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a)) *
    (Real.sqrt ((1 / a^2) - 1) - 1 / a) = -1 := by

  have ha1 : 0 < a := ha.1
  have ha2 : a < 1 := ha.2
  have ha3 : 0 < 1 - a := by linarith
  have ha4 : 0 < 1 + a := by linarith
  have ha5 : 0 < 1 - a^2 := by nlinarith

  have h1 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) = Real.sqrt (1 - a) * Real.sqrt (1 + a) := by
    have h2 : (1 - a^2 : ℝ) = (1 - a) * (1 + a) := by
      nlinarith
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (1 - a : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h4 : 0 ≤ (1 + a : ℝ) := by linarith
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by nlinarith)]

  have h2 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a)) = (1 + a + Real.sqrt (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (1 - a)) / (2 * a) := by
    have h3 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a) ≠ 0 := by
      have h4 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) > Real.sqrt (1 - a) := by
        apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt
        all_goals nlinarith
      nlinarith
    field_simp [h3]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + a), Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + a by linarith), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 - a by linarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3]
  
  have h3 : (1 - a) / (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a) = (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) + 1 - a) / (2 * a) := by
    have h4 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a ≠ 0 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1 - a ^ 2 : ℝ) by nlinarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3, sq_pos_of_pos ha4]
    field_simp [h4]
    have h5 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) ^ 2 = 1 - a^2 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 - a^2 by nlinarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3, sq_pos_of_pos ha4]
  
  have h4 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a)) + (1 - a) / (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a) = (1 + Real.sqrt (1 - a^2)) / a := by
    rw [h2, h3]
    have h5 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (1 - a) = Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) := by
      have h12 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (1 - a) = Real.sqrt ((1 + a) * (1 - a)) := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by nlinarith)]
      have h13 : (1 + a) * (1 - a) = 1 - a^2 := by
        nlinarith
      rw [h13] at h12
      linarith [h12]
    rw [h5] at h2
    field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith, show 1 - a ≠ 0 by linarith]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1 - a^2 : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
  
  have h5 : Real.sqrt ((1 / a^2) - 1) = Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) / a := by
    have h6 : (1 / a^2) - 1 = (1 - a^2) / a^2 := by
      field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith]
      <;> nlinarith
    rw [h6]
    have h7 : Real.sqrt ((1 - a^2) / a^2) = Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) / Real.sqrt (a^2) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_div (by nlinarith)]
    rw [h7]
    have h8 : Real.sqrt (a^2) = a := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (show 0 ≤ a by linarith)]
    rw [h8]

  have h6 : Real.sqrt ((1 / a^2) - 1) - 1 / a = (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1) / a := by
    rw [h5]
    field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith]
    all_goals linarith

  rw [h4, h6]

  have h7 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) ^ 2 = 1 - a^2 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    nlinarith

  field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith, h7]
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 - a^2 by nlinarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3]

/- Given $a={{\log }_{8}}5$, $b={{\log }_{4}}3$, $c=\frac{2}{3}$, the size relationship between $a$, $b$, and $c$ is (　　)

A:$a>b>c$

B:$b>c>a$

C:$b>a>c$

D:$c>b>a$ -/
theorem algebra_11391 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a = Real.logb 8 5) (hb : b = Real.logb 4 3) (hc : c = 2 / 3) :
    b > a ∧ a > c := by
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_11391 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a = Real.logb 8 5) (hb : b = Real.logb 4 3) (hc : c = 2 / 3) :
    b > a ∧ a > c := by
  have ha' : a = Real.log 5 / Real.log 8 := by 
    rw [ha]
    field_simp [Real.logb]
  
  have hb' : b = Real.log 3 / Real.log 4 := by 
    rw [hb]
    field_simp [Real.logb]

  have h1 : Real.log 8 = 3 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (8 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 3 by norm_num]
    simp [Real.log_pow]
    all_goals linarith
  
  have h2 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 by norm_num]
    simp [Real.log_pow]
    all_goals linarith
  
  have ha'' : a = Real.log 5 / (3 * Real.log 2) := by
    rw [ha']
    rw [h1]
  
  have hb'' : b = Real.log 3 / (2 * Real.log 2) := by
    rw [hb']
    rw [h2]

  have h3 : Real.log 2 > 0 := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    all_goals linarith
  
  have h3' : b > a := by
    rw [hb'', ha'']
    have h4 : 3 * Real.log 3 > 2 * Real.log 5 := by 
      have h5 : 3 * Real.log 3 = Real.log (3 ^ 3 : ℝ) := by
        simp [Real.log_pow]
      have h6 : 2 * Real.log 5 = Real.log (5 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by 
        simp [Real.log_pow]
      rw [h5, h6]
      have h7 : Real.log (3 ^ 3 : ℝ) > Real.log (5 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by
        apply Real.log_lt_log
        all_goals norm_num
      linarith
    have h5 : Real.log 3 / (2 * Real.log 2) > Real.log 5 / (3 * Real.log 2) := by 
      have h6 : Real.log 2 > 0 := h3
      have h7 : 3 * Real.log 3 > 2 * Real.log 5 := h4
      have h8 : Real.log 3 / (2 * Real.log 2) - Real.log 5 / (3 * Real.log 2) > 0 := by
        have pos1 : 2 * Real.log 2 > 0 := by nlinarith
        have pos2 : 3 * Real.log 2 > 0 := by nlinarith
        have h9 : Real.log 3 / (2 * Real.log 2) - Real.log 5 / (3 * Real.log 2) =
            (3 * Real.log 3 - 2 * Real.log 5) / (6 * Real.log 2) := by 
          field_simp
          <;> ring
        rw [h9]
        apply div_pos
        linarith
        all_goals linarith
      linarith
    linarith

  have h4 : a > c := by
    rw [ha'', hc]
    have h3 : Real.log 2 > 0 := h3
    have h4 : Real.log 5 > 2 * Real.log 2 := by 
      have h5 : Real.log 5 > Real.log (4 : ℝ) := by 
        apply Real.log_lt_log
        all_goals norm_num
      have h6 : Real.log (4 : ℝ) = 2 * Real.log 2 := by 
        rw [show (4 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 by norm_num]
        simp [Real.log_pow]
      linarith
    have h5 : Real.log 5 / (3 * Real.log 2) > (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      have pos1 : Real.log 2 > 0 := h3
      have h6 : Real.log 5 > 2 * Real.log 2 := h4
      have h7 : Real.log 5 / (3 * Real.log 2) - (2 / 3 : ℝ) > 0 := by
        have h8 : Real.log 2 > 0 := h3
        have h9 : Real.log 5 / (3 * Real.log 2) - (2 / 3 : ℝ) = (Real.log 5 - 2 * Real.log 2) / (3 * Real.log 2) := by 
          field_simp
          <;> ring
        rw [h9]
        apply div_pos
        linarith
        all_goals linarith
      linarith
    linarith
  
  constructor
  · linarith [h3']
  · linarith [h4]
